approved: 2026-10-23 by Christelle, from the Mon Srixon Z-Star designs
product_rule: real packshot only, cut out of its white background, never redrawn; Pillow flood-fill cut-out

rotation.note: 3 layouts: a layout never repeats within 2 product posts, so it returns at most every third post. layout_for() also keeps multi-product posts off one-hero.

copy_limits.headline: exactly 2 lines, each <=14 chars, auto-shrinks
copy_limits.claims: no performance or ranking claims; any number needs a source link

name: Product post: one hero (charcoal)
background: #3A3A3A fading to #0C0A0B (gradient^1.3), 4px white frame at 47% alpha inset 33px

headline.font: Black Italic <=150, width<=560, line 1 white, line 2 accent (orange default)

hero.note: bleeds past the right frame on purpose

best_for: one standout product with a strong shape: a ball, a putter head, a bag, a glove
